name: Zenithal-Crucible
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against towering mountain ranges, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the derelict space station in orbit left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
